name: Frontend Notices
author: Berqier Web Design

sections.description:
Design Stunning Notice Bars with Ease!

Elevate your website’s user experience with Frontend Notices, the ultimate WordPress plugin that empowers you to create beautifully designed notice bars using any page builder. Engage your visitors effectively with our advanced targeting features, ensuring your messages reach the right audience at the right time.

Key Features

  • Seamless Page Builder Integration: Effortlessly design notice bars with your favorite page builder. No coding skills required!

  • Advanced Targeting Options: Tailor your notices to specific audiences:

    • Post Types: Show notices on selected post types for maximum relevance.
    • Mobile-Only Notices: Optimize user engagement by displaying notices exclusively on mobile devices.
    • User Status Targeting: Choose to target:
    • Logged-in users
    • Logged-out users
    • All users

  • User Role Targeting: Direct messages to specific user roles, ensuring your notices resonate with each audience segment.

  • Customizable Designs: Craft visually appealing notices that blend seamlessly with your website’s theme and style.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and unzip the plugin file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I customize my notices?

To customize your notices, go to WordPress Dashboard > Notices > Add New. Here, you can design the notice using any page builder.

At the bottom of the notice edit page, you will find the notice settings to adjust targeting and display options.

Can I show notices only on mobile devices?

Yes! You can choose to display notices exclusively on mobile devices.

Is there support available for this plugin?

Absolutely! Users can utilize the WordPress plugin support forum for any ideas, bug reports, or assistance. We appreciate all suggestions and feedback!

How do I report bugs or submit feature ideas?

Please use the WordPress plugin support forum to report bugs or share your feature ideas. Your feedback helps us improve the plugin!
